user.title: Private HACS
user.description:
Releases are installed **only if their `vX.Y.Z` tag is signed by one of your trusted SSH keys**.

Paste your **public** signing key(s), one per line (`ssh-ed25519 AAAA… comment`; only Ed25519 is supported).

No GitHub token is stored: you will paste it each time you add, install or update a repository.

error.invalid_signers: Not a valid list of ssh-ed25519 public keys (one per line).

repository_action.title: {repo}
repository_action.description:
Install / update takes the newest `vX.Y.Z` tag that verifies unless you enter one, and refuses anything not signed by a trusted key. It needs a **[fine-grained token]({fine_url})** (Contents: Read-only) that is used for this action only and **not stored**; roll back and remove do not need it. Home Assistant must be restarted afterwards.

{detail}
